New native SQLite files write config version 2 and carry no root; config version 1 files, which were written while the root was fabricated and never persisted a root write, keep their implicit reserved root so their existing data retains the semantics its writer intended, and unknown config versions are ErrCorrupt rather than being guessed at. The native test corpus now declares its root dependency: fixtures that address conversation 1 create it before the store is owned (seedRootConversation, the apply helper, and the sqliteStore/sqliteStoreFresh split), and seq-relative replay fixtures run against a version 1 store so every captured sequence number and document point stays intact.
